pages.title: Personal
pages.one: Your own notes, meetings and calendar; helpers see only what you allow.

steps.text: You turn on a part (Notes, Meetings, Calendar) and set its rules
steps.detail: Per part: what helpers may read (nothing, only what you attach to a ticket, all) and whether they may add notes.

steps.text: A helper asks Personal for a note, a meeting or free times
Checks the rules before it hands anything over
steps.detail: Not allowed: the helper asks you on its ticket. A calendar at Nothing is left out; Busy times show without a title.

steps.text: Gets text only, as information, never as orders
Writes a new note into From helpers or suggests a meeting time
steps.detail: It never changes or deletes your notes and never adds an event; a suggestion waits for you.

steps.text: You add the suggestion to your calendar or make tickets from next steps

good: A recording is read only after you said everyone on the call agreed. Ways in are your own scripts on this computer: they run only their listed actions and stop when their folder changes.

cmds: parts that are on and what helpers can use
free times in the calendars a helper may see
each way in that is on
files: its rules and data, kept out of git
